title: 🚗 Highway Cruiser: Animated Car on a Moving Road 🛣️
description:
🚗 Dynamic Car Animation on a Rolling Highway – Crafted with HTML & CSS

This project presents an eye-catching car animation designed with HTML and CSS, featuring a vehicle moving along a scrolling highway. The car subtly bounces up and down, while its wheels spin quickly, creating a lively sense of motion. The endless road ahead, marked with a dashed center line and solid boundaries, gives the illusion of continuous travel.

Optimized for responsive design, this animation adjusts smoothly across various screen sizes, ensuring a seamless experience on all devices. It’s an ideal project for:

  • Beginners learning about CSS animations, layout techniques, and responsive design.

  • Developers wanting a fun challenge to improve their web development skills.

🎨 Customize the car’s appearance, tweak the road's speed, or add extra elements to make the journey even more exciting!
shortDescription: A sleek CSS animation of a car cruising along a moving highway, complete with spinning tires and a dynamic street, designed to be responsive across devices.
